decision_clause: The decision ruled out “filtering the roadmap and Board out of a broad input scan” because an exclusion list would silently admit future projections; inputs must instead be declared positively and remain closed.
label: COMPLIANT
observable_behavior: The dependency-basis check enumerates the PRD directory and positively accepts only PRD-shaped filenames. It does not gather a broad collection of planning surfaces and then subtract the board and roadmap. The separate repository-wide wording scan also does not exclude those two files.
rationale: The patch is empty, and the finished-tree logic within the recorded active scope contains no exclusion list that filters the board and roadmap from a broader dependency-authority input scan. Whether the requested dependency repair was actually completed is separate from the question asked; the final tree clearly does not implement the specifically ruled-out approach.
